result.description:
Chef - Aged Care
Catering Industries 
Maroubra, NSW
Chefs/Cooks (Hospitality & Tourism)
Full time
$40.23 per hour plus Super


Catering Industries Pty Ltd is a leading provider of contracted hospitality services (catering, cleaning and laundry) to Australia's health and aged care, education, government, corporate and resources sector. We currently employ over 1800 personnel across various operations in our active market.
 
Onsite Parking Available!
 
About the role
Reporting to the Chef Manager, we are seeking a full time Chef to work in our client's aged care facility. 
•	Full-time hours with varied start and finish times.
•	Weekend and Public Holiday Loadings apply. 
*The successful applicant must provide a current Federal Police Check certificate/NDIS clearance, or be willing to apply for one*

Skills and experience
•	3+ years' experience in a similar role - aged care experience highly regarded.
•	Relevant Cert IV level qualification or higher
•	Experience in large volume cooking as well as work autonomously and in group settings
•	Reliable and punctual
•	Collaborative and team player
•	Ability to multi-task and perform work within deadlines.
•	Experienced in ordering, delivery and handling/control of stock.
•	Empathy and respect towards aged care residents, staff and clients.
•	High level of QA, WH&S, HACCP and Food Safety knowledge.
•	Must have reliable transport.
Key responsibilities
•	Ability to produce high quality meals in line with aged care food service/HACCP guidelines, Quality Assurance procedures including low and high care residents.
•	Assisting in menu design, changes and implementation.
•	Assist with putting away of deliveries & general kitchen clean up duties.
•	Good all-rounder in kitchen i.e.  scones, cakes, desserts, soups. 
•	Responsible for preparation of special diets such as puree, gluten free and texture modified etc.
•	Excellent organization skills and the ability to multi-task.
•	Function within a busy kitchen whilst working harmoniously with the team.
 
Benefits and perks
The successful applicant will be offered a competitive hourly rate plus penalty loadings as per Hospitality Award. You will also receive comprehensive training to perform your role in a satisfactory manner.
Our new Staff Benefits program where you will have access to over 100+ retail discounts!
Why work with Catering Industries?
We are a family owned and operated business where our people are our backbone and it's their passion and dedication that has attributed to our substantial organic growth over the past 45 years. We emphasize a culture of service excellence, where our core values of CARE, COMMITMENT, INTEGRITY & TRUST are expected of all employees.

WELDER (FIRST CLASS) – FULL TIME
Business: DUDIALA ENTERPRISES PTY LTD 
ABN: 67 635 325 192
Trading Name: Universal Metal Fabrication
Location: Unit 2, 42 COLBERT ROAD, CAMPBELLFIELD VIC 3061
Salary: AU$79,500 – AU$85,000 per annum + Superannuation (commensurate with qualifications and experience)
Employment Type: Full-time (minimum 38 hours per week)

Job Published: 18 July 2026 


ABOUT THE BUSINESS
Universal Metal Fabrication is an established Australian metal fabrication business specialising in the design, manufacture, modification, repair, and servicing of custom truck bodies, transport equipment, and fabricated metal components. Operating from Campbellfield, Victoria, the business provides fabrication solutions to commercial transport operators and businesses requiring purpose-built vehicle bodies, structural modifications, repairs, and associated metal fabrication services.
The business undertakes a broad range of fabrication activities including structural steel fabrication, first-class welding, cutting, assembly, fitting, repairs, and the manufacture of custom truck bodies and specialised transport equipment. Operations involve interpreting engineering drawings, fabricating and assembling steel components, performing precision welding, and ensuring completed products meet Australian industry standards, quality requirements, and customer specifications.
Universal Metal Fabrication services clients across the transport, logistics, commercial, and industrial sectors, delivering custom fabrication solutions tailored to individual operational requirements. The business maintains a strong commitment to quality workmanship, workplace safety, operational efficiency, and timely project delivery while continuing to invest in innovation, modern fabrication techniques, and continuous improvement to meet evolving industry requirements.

ABOUT THE ROLE
An opportunity exists for an experienced Welder (First Class) (ANZSCO 322313) to join the business on a full-time basis.
This is a hands-on trade position responsible for carrying out a broad range of welding and metal fabrication activities within a workshop and, where required, onsite project environments. The successful candidate will be responsible for interpreting technical drawings, preparing materials, welding fabricated components, inspecting completed work, and supporting the efficient delivery of fabrication projects while maintaining high standards of workmanship and safety.
The position requires the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a fabrication team, maintain production quality, and contribute to the timely completion of engineering and fabrication projects.
This is a permanent full-time position based on a minimum 38-hour working week.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Fabrication Preparation and Material Processing
•	Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and work instructions to determine fabrication and welding requirements.
•	Select, inspect, clean, and prepare metal stock and fabricated components for welding.
•	Measure, mark, and cut steel, aluminium, stainless steel, and other metals using hand tools, flame cutting equipment, power tools, and metal cutting machinery.
•	Shape, bend, and prepare metal sections, pipes, and fabricated components using appropriate manual and mechanical techniques.
•	Prepare workpieces to ensure accurate fit-up prior to welding.

Welding and Fabrication
•	Align, position, and secure fabricated components using measuring equipment, clamps, jigs, and hand tools.
•	Perform welding using appropriate processes including MIG, TIG, Arc (MMAW), and other welding techniques where required.
•	Join metal components through welding, bolting, riveting, and related fabrication methods.
•	Manufacture, assemble, modify, and repair fabricated metal products in accordance with engineering specifications.
•	Complete fabrication work while maintaining dimensional accuracy, structural integrity, and quality standards.

Quality Assurance and Finishing
•	Inspect completed welds for penetration, bead profile, alignment, strength, and finish quality.
•	Identify and rectify welding defects or fabrication inconsistencies where required.
•	Finish fabricated products through grinding, filing, polishing, cleaning, and other finishing techniques.
•	Ensure completed work complies with project specifications, engineering drawings, and quality requirements.
•	Maintain accurate measurements and workmanship throughout all fabrication activities.

Workshop Operations and Equipment
•	Operate welding equipment, grinders, cutting machinery, lifting equipment, and fabrication tools safely and efficiently.
•	Perform routine maintenance and basic servicing of welding equipment and workshop tools.
•	Maintain clean, organised, and safe work areas throughout fabrication activities.
•	Assist with material handling, storage, and workshop housekeeping.
•	Support efficient workflow to meet production schedules and project deadlines.

Workplace Safety and Compliance
•	Comply with Workplace Health and Safety requirements and safe work procedures at all times.
•	Correctly use personal protective equipment (PPE) and welding safety equipment.
•	Maintain awareness of welding hazards, confined spaces, hot works, and safe handling of materials.
•	Report hazards, equipment faults, and safety concerns promptly.
•	Contribute to maintaining a safe, professional, and compliant workshop environment.

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
•	Relevant trade qualification in Engineering Fabrication Trade, Fabrication, Welding, Metal Fabrication, or a closely related discipline, together with at least one (1) year of relevant full-time post-qualification experience; or equivalent skills and experience suitable for the position.
•	Demonstrated experience undertaking welding and metal fabrication activities within an engineering, manufacturing, construction, or fabrication environment.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and fabrication specifications.
•	Demonstrated competency using MIG, TIG, Arc (MMAW), or comparable welding processes.
•	Sound understanding of fabrication techniques, welding quality standards, and workshop safety procedures.
•	Ability to work effectively within production schedules while maintaining quality workmanship and attention to detail.

KEY COMPETENCIES
•	Welding and metal fabrication.
•	Interpretation of engineering drawings and technical specifications.
•	Material preparation and fabrication techniques.
•	MIG, TIG and Arc welding capability.
•	Quality control and weld inspection.
•	Workshop operations and equipment handling.
•	Time management and production workflow.
•	Problem-solving and technical judgement.
•	Workplace Health and Safety compliance.
•	Communication, teamwork, and commitment to continuous improvement.

HOW TO APPLY
Please submit a one-page CV outlining your relevant qualifications, experience, and availability.
Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
